items.title: India’s satellite supply chain ‘highly dependent on imports’, says space body
items.text: India’s space economy is currently valued at nearly $9 billion and is set to grow to $40-45 billion in less than a decade

items.title: ECI directs states to correct erroneous entries in SIR rolls through Form 8 during ongoing Special Summary Revision
items.text: ECI directs corrections of erroneous SSR entries using Form 8 after SIR verification across 25 states/UTs.

items.title: Fuel tanker crash ignites massive fire on highway surrounding Cairo, killing at least 30 people
items.text: The blaze on Ring Road, a key artery that encircles the Egyptian capital, also injured at least 25 people and left more than two dozen cars and motorcycles charred, the Public Prosecutor’s office said in a statement

items.title: Airtel to invest ₹1,200 cr in 3 data centers in Assam
items.text: Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore to build three Assam data centres (Guwahati, Jorhat, Silchar) by 2028, boosting digital infrastructure and jobs.

items.title: U.S. announces new 25% tariffs on India, second-highest in the 14 countries against which action has been taken
items.text: The order by the U.S. Trade Representative also opens the door for a lower 17% tariff if India and the U.S. sign a trade deal
